title: Swahili Chicken and Rice
community: Swahili coast — the everyday celebration one-pot
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Swahili Chicken and Rice — chicken slow-cooked in a fragrant Zanzibar spice sauce, its rich broth used to cook basmati rice to golden perfection, the chicken placed back on top for the final steam. A simpler version of chicken pilau — all the flavour, half the work.
longDesc: Swahili chicken and rice is the everyday version of chicken pilau — same flavours, same technique, less effort. It is the mid-week celebration dish for coastal Tanzanian families.
ingredients: // Spices: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cardamom, ¼ tsp cloves
steps: Cook onions golden. Add garlic, ginger, spices, tomatoes. Cook 8 minutes.
Return chicken. Add water. Simmer covered 35—40 minutes until very tender.
Remove chicken. Measure broth — need 5 cups. Add rice.
Boil, then cover, lowest heat 20 minutes.
Place chicken atop rice. Rest 10 minutes.
chefTips: Bone-in chicken is essential for the broth.
cookingScience: See TZA056 for chicken pilau science.
culturalNote: Swahili chicken and rice is the coastal family's most reliable celebration dish — made on birthdays, homecomings, and Friday afternoons when the week has been good.
